info.title: LearnMate API
info.description: AI-powered personalized learning companion backend for students.

get.description: Return application status and verify database connectivity.
Return safe readiness indicators without exposing secret keys.

post.description:
Reset demo student data (materials, quizzes, mastery, misconceptions, revision tasks).
Protected to prevent accidental execution in production.

Upload and index a PDF document page-by-page.
Extracts text, preserves page numbers, and breaks content into searchable chunks.

get.description: Retrieve all study materials for the demo student with pagination.

post.description: Store and index pasted study notes with section references.

get.description: Retrieve metadata and chunk statistics for a single study material.

delete.description: Delete study material and its indexed chunks. Associated quiz sessions retain material_id=NULL.

get.description: Retrieve extracted chunks with page/section numbers.

post.summary: Ask AI Tutor Grounded in Study Material
post.description:
Ask a question grounded exclusively in the student's study material.
Returns page-level/section citations and abstains when evidence is insufficient.

Generate a diagnostic, practice, or follow-up multiple-choice quiz grounded in study material.
Answer keys are strictly withheld until submission.

get.description: Retrieve quiz questions with grading keys safely hidden.

post.summary: Submit Quiz Answers for Server-Side Grading
post.description:
Submit answers for objective server-side evaluation.
Calculates score, reveals explanations, updates topic mastery, and records misconceptions.

get.description:
Retrieve topic-level mastery estimates and knowledge gaps.
Topics are categorized as 'weak', 'developing', 'strong', or 'not_enough_data'.
Retrieve diagnosed student misconceptions grounded in actual incorrect answers.
Retrieve overall learning progress, quiz scores, topic trends, and recent activity.

post.description:
Create a verification tracking session comparing an initial diagnostic assessment
with a subsequent follow-up assessment on the same topic.

get.description:
Retrieve comparative results between initial and follow-up assessments.
Accurately computes score delta if both have been submitted.
Retrieve persisted revision tasks prioritized by urgency and topic mastery.

post.summary: Generate or Update Adaptive Revision Tasks
post.description:
Generate or update recommendations using topic mastery, recent quiz performance,
outstanding tasks, and previous attempts. Returns a transparent starter plan if no history exists.
